The {{tt|Ultra Reconnaissance Team|Ultra Recon Squad}}!'') is the 27th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}} meet [[Dulse]] and [[Zossie]] of the [[Ultra Recon Squad]]. * Dulse reveals that he worked with the [[Aether Foundation]] simply to make [[Poké Ball]]s capable of capturing [[Ultra Beast]]s. * [[Nebby|Lunala]] returns to Sun and Moon. * Dulse agrees to stay behind while Zossie goes with Sun and Moon on Lunala. * With Zossie's guidance, Sun and Moon arrive at the [[Ultra Megalopolis]]. {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== * [[Soliera]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Poipole}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sun}} * {{adv|Moon}} * [[Dulse]] * [[Zossie]] * [[Soliera]] ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Torracat}} ({{adv|Dollar}}; {{adv|Sun}}'s) * {{p|Dartrix}} ({{OP|Moon|Dartrix}}) * {{p|Zygarde}} ({{adv|Zygarde|Adventures}}; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Zygarde|Zygarde Cells and 10% Forme}}) * {{p|Lunala}} ([[Nebby]]) * {{p|Necrozma}} ({{adv|Necrozma|Adventures}}; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Necrozma|Dusk Mane Necrozma}}) * {{p|Poipole}} * {{p|Nihilego}} (multiple) ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemelight|SM}}|bordercolor={{colorschemedark|SM}} |zh_cmn={{tt|邂逅！终极调查队！|Encounter!!
